_comment: Per-locale headline copy baked onto the App Store screenshots by appstore.yml, keyed by the
forge state each raw capture in screenshots/ was taken from. Version-controlled here, next to the
rest of the listing, so the copy is reviewable in a PR rather than living only in a CI script.
This file is DELIBERATELY outside the metadata tool's schema. `asc metadata validate` decodes only
version/<v>/<locale>.json and app-info/<locale>.json, and its decode is STRICT — an unknown key
there fails with `json: unknown field "..."`. Since appstore-metadata-validate is a REQUIRED status
check, putting headlines in those files would freeze every merge. `asc` ignores this subtree.
No length limit applies: unlike `keywords` (<=100) these are not Apple fields, and the compositor's
`caption:` word-wraps inside a fixed box, so any copy length fits by construction.
Changing a headline needs NO macOS run — appstore.yml re-composites from the committed raws.
